text:
zara: noticed a quick p99 wobble for /v1/complete on the latency dashboard right after the routing weight flip; p50 steady so it's tail-only. anyone else?
pete: yep, saw EU shard spike. panel uses tdigest_merge over 1m rollups. could be aggregation or real variance from pool change.
jing: quick check: infra changed rollup window to 1m and adjusted histogram bins yesterday to reduce noise. that combo often causes UI percentiles to drift vs raw.
monitor-bot: Deploy bot: routing-weight-update deployed 2024-11-15T02:05Z by ci/cd. No failed checks. :white_check_mark:
zara: copying the panel query for context:
```
SELECT quantile_from_tdigest(tdigest_merge(latency_tdigest),0.99) AS p99 FROM endpoint_rollups WHERE endpoint='/v1/complete' AND time >= now() - 2h GROUP BY time(1m)
```
pete: thanks. can we quickly replay a bursty trace with 15s vs 60s rollup merge and with old vs new histogram bins? that usually tells if it's an aggregation artifact.
jing: replayed locally: merge=15s p99_ui ~= p99_raw; merge=60s p99_ui jumps ~2x while raw p99 stays flat. sample_count low during spike (<80).
zara: so likely aggregation artifact. action list: (1) add dashboard annotation at deploy time; (2) add "percentile provenance" hover showing "source=tdigest_merge(1m);samples=N;histogram=bins_v2"; (3) add a manual "overlay raw samples" dashed-line toggle for endpoints when sample_count >= 50; (4) add CI replay test that fails if UI p99 diverges >30% from raw for sensitive endpoints when sampling changes.
pete: agree. also propose a small gating note in rollout UI: "If rollup/sampling config changed within last 1h, percentiles may reflect aggregation artifacts."
jing: I'll open infra PR to restore previous histogram boundaries for now and add provenance metadata to rollup docs. pete: I'll do the console hover mock + overlay toggle. zara: adding dashboard annotation and filing SLO doc note so oncall isn't paged for noise.
monitor-bot: Job infra/rollup-backfill started to add provenance metadata to recent rollups.
zara: thanks team. closing once revert + overlay toggle live and CI replay added. :thumbsup:
